release.title: Portal Preparation, Sub-Platform Coordination, and Manhattan-Led Professional Growth
release.artifactSha256Location: External exact-artifact test record and final delivery summary

changes.problem: Public users could choose a focused portal but lacked a privacy-preserving way to organize confirmed facts, materials, questions, goals, and access needs for the handoff.
changes.implementation: Added a device-only Portal Preparation Pack with portal scope/availability, local text and JSON exports, user-controlled clearing, and explicit no-upload/no-save/no-AI/no-routing/no-deadline boundaries.

changes.problem: The umbrella Control Center did not provide a concise current owner-recorded view of independently versioned sub-platform artifacts and next actions.
changes.implementation: Added a protected 21-record portal release snapshot with artifact names, relationships, deployment cautions, next actions, and JSON export while preserving dedicated-artifact authority.

changes.problem: The required rotation called for Manhattan to lead the next accurate three-market profile batch.
changes.implementation: Added 17 source-tracked individual professionals, 1 firm, and 17 professional–firm links: 8 Manhattan, 5 Brooklyn, and 4 Northern Metro New Jersey. All remain unclaimed, unverified, nonparticipating, unpaid, and inquiry-ineligible.

changes.problem: The inherited SBOM document name and namespace still identified v1.7.18 inside the v1.7.19 package.
changes.implementation: Regenerated the dependency SBOM from the v1.7.20 package and unchanged lockfile so the document identity matches the current release without changing dependencies.

profileGrowth.sourcePolicy: Current professional-controlled firm and individual profile pages were used for public identity, role, business office, and conservatively summarized practice facts. Credential status remains unverified until an independent official licensing review. No testimonials, rankings, badges, case outcomes, ratings, or inferred specialties are copied.
excludedOrDeferred: No new profile outside Manhattan, Brooklyn, or Hudson County.
Profiles without current individual-level role and practice evidence or a published business office were deferred.
Radius search remains closed until verified coordinates and distance rules exist.
Professional outreach, credential approval, claim approval, paid participation, and inquiry eligibility remain separate closed workflows.

tests.covers: device-only boundaries, local exports, labels, and public discovery links
21-record owner snapshot, version truth, dedicated-artifact authority, and protected rendering/export
batch counts, sources, firm links, market totals, strict profile totals, neutrality, and closed eligibility
version consistency, runtime routes, owner protection, exact directory totals, SBOM identity, and closed gates

closedGates: sensitive external AI without approved controls

dependencyAdvisoryCheck.result: A controlled npm advisory request on 2026-07-22 reached the configured package registry but the audit endpoint returned HTTP 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable.
dependencyAdvisoryCheck.claim: No fresh v1.7.20 vulnerability count is claimed.

dependencyVerification.cleanInstallResult: The configured package registry did not complete a controlled clean install in the build environment; the advisory endpoint separately returned HTTP 503.
dependencyVerification.regressionMethod: The complete 37-part suite passed in the working tree and again from fresh extraction using temporary external test-only pg and nodemailer compatibility modules outside the repository and excluded from the release ZIP.
dependencyVerification.lockfileComparison: Dependency declarations remain unchanged; only the root package version is updated. The lockfile contains 15 approved public-registry dependency artifacts.
